mapper.sql: c.del_flag = 0 and c.scope_type = 1 and c.merchant_id is not null and (c.status is null or c.status not in (2, 3, 4)) and (c.enable_time is null or c.enable_time <= now()) and (c.start_time is null or c.start_time <= now()) and (c.end_time is null or c.end_time > now()) and (c.publish_count is null or c.publish_count <= 0 or ifnull(c.receive_count, 0) < c.publish_count)
mapper.select: select c.id as couponId, c.name as name, c.description as description, c.coupon_type as couponType, c.amount as amount, c.min_point as minPoint, date_format(c.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime, case when c.publish_count is null or c.publish_count <= 0 then null else greatest(0, c.publish_count - ifnull(c.receive_count, 0)) end as remaining, m.id as merchantId, m.name as merchantName, p.id as poiId, p.lat as lat, p.lng as lng, coalesce(nullif(p.cover_img, ''), m.cover_image) as coverImg, (#{memberId} is not null and exists (select 1 from marketplace_deal_claim k where k.coupon_id = c.id and k.member_id = #{memberId})) as claimed from marketplace_deal d join sms_coupon c on c.id = d.coupon_id join mms_merchant m on m.id = c.merchant_id join roam_poi p on p.id = ( select p2.id from roam_poi p2 where p2.merchant_id = m.id and p2.type = 2 and p2.status = 1 and (p2.application_type is null or p2.application_type = 2 or (p2.application_type in (1, 3) and p2.audit_status = 1)) and p2.lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and p2.lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng} order by p2.node_level desc, p2.id asc limit 1) where d.enabled = 1 and and order by d.sort desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}

select c.id, c.status, c.publish_count as publishCount, c.receive_count as receiveCount, c.start_time as startTime, c.end_time as endTime, c.enable_time as enableTime from marketplace_deal d join sms_coupon c on c.id = d.coupon_id join mms_merchant m on m.id = c.merchant_id where d.coupon_id = #{couponId} and d.enabled = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 and c.scope_type = 1 and for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into marketplace_deal_claim (coupon_id, member_id, create_time) values (#{couponId}, #{memberId}, now())
mapper.select: select history_id from marketplace_deal_claim where coupon_id = #{couponId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update marketplace_deal_claim set history_id = #{historyId} where coupon_id = #{couponId} and member_id = #{memberId} and history_id is null
mapper.select: select d.coupon_id as couponId, d.enabled, d.sort, d.update_by as updateBy, date_format(coalesce(d.update_time, d.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime, c.name as couponName, c.status as couponStatus, c.publish_count as publishCount, c.receive_count as receiveCount, date_format(c.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime, m.id as merchantId, m.name as merchantName, (select count(*) from marketplace_deal_claim k where k.coupon_id = d.coupon_id) as claimCount from marketplace_deal d left join sms_coupon c on c.id = d.coupon_id left join mms_merchant m on m.id = c.merchant_id order by d.enabled desc, d.sort desc, d.coupon_id desc limit 500
mapper.insert: insert into marketplace_deal (coupon_id, enabled, sort, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{couponId}, #{enabled}, 0, #{operator}, now(), #{operator}, now()) on duplicate key update enabled = values(enabled), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select count(*) from sms_coupon c where c.id = #{couponId} and c.del_flag = 0 and c.scope_type = 1 and c.merchant_id is not null

select o.id as orderId, o.order_sn as orderSn, o.mms_merchant_id as merchantId, m.name as merchantName, o.pay_amount as payAmount, date_format(o.payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as paymentTime, o.entitlement_days as entitlementDays, case when r.order_id is null then 'none' when r.refund_fact_id is null then 'requested' else 'settled' end as refundState from oms_order o left join mms_merchant m on m.id = o.mms_merchant_id left join merchant_commerce_refund r on r.order_id = o.id where o.biz_type = 'promotion_slot' and o.status = 1 order by o.payment_time desc, o.id desc limit 500

select g.name as name, round(g.lat, 2) as areaLat, round(g.lng, 2) as areaLng, g.visitors as checkinCount, date_format(g.last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastSeen from ( select v.poi_name as name, round(v.lat, 3) as lat, round(v.lng, 3) as lng, count(*) as visitors, max(v.first_visit_time) as last_seen from member_visited_poi v where v.poi_name is not null and v.poi_name <> '' and v.poi_name <> '未知地点' and v.lat is not null and v.lng is not null and v.first_visit_time >= #{since} group by v.poi_name, round(v.lat, 3), round(v.lng, 3) having count(*) >= #{minVisitors} ) g where not exists ( select 1 from roam_poi p where p.status = 1 and p.lat between g.lat - 0.0006 and g.lat + 0.0006 and p.lng between g.lng - 0.0006 and g.lng + 0.0006) order by g.visitors desc, g.last_seen desc limit #{limit}

select id as productId, product_name as productName, pic, price, original_price as originalPrice, unit from pms_product where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and publish_status = 1 and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0) order by id desc limit 50

select s.id as skuId, s.product_id as productId, s.sku_name as skuName, cast(s.price as char) as price, cast(s.original_price as char) as originalPrice from pms_sku s join pms_product p on p.id = s.product_id where p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and p.publish_status = 1 and (p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = 0) order by s.product_id desc, s.id asc limit 500
